independent.summary: The floor filter is still applied conditionally on a stale read: `demotingAnOwner`/`removingAnOwner` (lines 344, 411) come from the request's own `membersOf()` read, so when a member read as `editor` is concurrently promoted to `owner` while the other owner is concurrently demoted, the in-flight PATCH (or DELETE) runs with no `anotherOwnerThan` in its filter, matches, and lands — leaving the workspace with zero owners, the exact permanent state the item exists to prevent. Applying the filter whenever the target role is not `owner` (and unconditionally on removal) closes it; the write-level invariant is only as strong as the read-derived branch in front of it.
